jobs.occupation: Lagermedarbejder til manuelt lagerpluk / Warehouse worker for manual stock picking
jobs.description:
Frisk og energisk kollega søges som lagermedarbejdere hos fødevare virksomhed.

Vi er en fødevare virksomhed som søger en kollega med lyst til at plukke og pakke varer til en bred vifte af restauratører på hele Sjælland.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst og søger hele tiden nye arbejdsområder og har derfor brug for dygtige lagerfolk, der kan indgå i teams med mange forskellige kolleger.

Lagerarbejde i et mangfoldigt og sundt arbejdsmiljø
Som lagermedarbejder får du en tempofyldt hverdag med mange opgaver. Sammen med dine kolleger skal du sørge for, at de rigtige varer bliver klar til udlevering i det aftalte antal.

Opgaver

• 
Plukke varer fra lageret 

• 
Opfyldning

• 
Varemodtagelse

• 
Andre ad. hoc lageropgaver

Din udvikling i din stilling, samt muligheder for forbedringer er noget vi holder øjemed, så vi hele tiden kan skabe et fælles og godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor orden, kvalitet og automatisering er i fokus.

Engagement & fleksibilitet
Du har muligvis erfaring med lager- eller logistikarbejde fra en tidligere stilling. Vi søger både kollega med og uden truckcertifikat. Det er vigtigt, at du er fleksibel og trives godt med at arbejde i et dynamisk miljø, hvor vi lægger vægt på nøjagtighed og kvalitet.

Du er god til at prioritere og planlægge dine opgaver selvstændigt, og det falder diglige så nemt at arbejde sammen med teamet om at løse en opgave.

Fortrukne sprogkundskaber i prioriteret orden;
1. Tyrkisk   2. Kurdisk   3. Dansk    4. Engelsk

Løn
Løn aftales ifht. kvalifikationer. Som minimum aflønnes på baggrund af fællesoverenskomst mellem DI Overenskomst II og 3F Fagligt Fælles Forbund, Transportgruppen - for lagerarbejdere, chauffører og havnearbejdere.

Send din ansøgning og CV til job@megahouse.dk, markeret med ”Lagermedarbejder” i emnefeltet og du vil høre fra os.

 

 

(ENGLISH)
Fresh and energetic colleague are wanted as warehouse workers at a foodservice company.

We are a foodservice company looking for an employee with a desire to pick and packgoods for a wide range of restaurateurs throughout Zealand.

We are a growing company and are constantly looking for new work areas and therefore need more skilled warehouse worker who can join teams with many differentcolleagues.

Warehouse work in a diverse and healthy working environment
As a warehouse employee, you will have a fast-paced everyday life with many tasks.Together with your colleagues, you must ensure that the right goods are ready for delivery in the agreed quantity.

Assignments

• 
Pick the right items from the warehouse

• 
Filling

• 
Goods receipt

• 
Other ad. hoc storage tasks

Your development in your position, as well as opportunities for improvement, is something we keep an eye on, so that we can constantly create a common and good working environment, where order, quality and automation are the focus.

Commitment & flexibility
You may have experience with warehouse or logistics work from a previous position.We are looking for both colleagues with and without a truck certificate. It is important that you are flexible and enjoy working in a dynamic environment where weemphasize accuracy and quality.

You are good at prioritizing and planning your tasks independently, and it is just as easy for you to work together with the team to solve a task.

Preferred language skills in priority order;
1. Turkish    2. Kurdish   3. Danish    4. English

Salary
Salary is agreed according to qualifications. As a minimum, wages are paid on the basis of a joint agreement between DI Agreement II and 3F Fagligt Fælles Forbund, the Transport group - for warehouse workers, drivers and dock workers.

Send your application and CV to job@megahouse.dk, marked with "Warehouse employee" in the subject field and you will hear from us.

• Restaurant management experience – you know how to run a smooth, profitable operation.

Your Responsibilities
As our Restaurant Manager, you will be the driving force behind our new concept. Your key tasks will include:

• Creating staff rotas – ensuring optimal coverage while respecting work-life balance.
• Leading service-quality training – coaching the team to deliver warm, professional, and consistent service.
• Working closely with the kitchen team – ensuring seamless coordination between front-of-house and back-of-house for a flawless end-to-end guest journey.
• Overseeing daily operations – from opening procedures to guest relations, inventory, and health & safety standards.
We offer:

• ·         Competitive salary
• ·         Opportunity for career development
• ·         Work in an exciting and dynamic environment

Ready to Make Some Noise?

If you’re excited to lead a restaurant that sings – literally and figuratively – we’d love to hear from you.

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter (in English) explaining your experience in management, service, and music/culture toramencopenhagen@gmail.com.

Do you enjoy turning plans into action and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives?  

Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics

The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• 
Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 

• 
Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 

• 
Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 

• 
Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 

• 
Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 

• 
Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 

• 
Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 

• 
Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 

• 
Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 

• 
Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 

• 
Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 

• 
Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 

Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

• 
Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 

• 
An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 

• 
Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 

• 
Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 

• 
An understanding of risk management and governance 

• 
Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 

• 
Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 

• 
Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis? 

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.occupation: Køkken souschef søges til burger restaurant i vækst
jobs.description:
Souschef søges til burgerrestaurant i vækst

Er du passioneret omkring mad, kvalitet og godt teamwork – og har du lyst til at være en vigtig del af en burgerrestaurant i rivende udvikling? Smash Burger Roskilde byder dig velkommen...

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret souschef, som vil være med til at sikre høj kvalitet, godt flow i køkkenet og et stærkt team.

Vi er en burgerrestaurant i Roskilde i rivende vækst, og derfor søger vi en person, der både kan tage ansvar i den daglige drift og samtidig har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som souschef bliver du en central del af køkkendriften. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

• 
At sikre høj kvalitet og ensartethed i vores mad

• 
At lede og motivere køkkenteamet i dagligdagen

• 
At sikre god struktur og effektivitet under travle serviceperioder

• 
At hjælpe med oplæring af nye medarbejdere

• 
At sikre, at hygiejne, rengøring og egenkontrol er i orden

• 
At assistere køkkenchefen med den daglige planlægning og drift

• 
At tage ansvar for køkkenet, når køkkenchefen ikke er til stede

• 
At bidrage med idéer til udvikling af menu, arbejdsgange og køkkendrift

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har erfaring fra et professionelt køkken – gerne som souschef, kok eller lignende

• 
Trives med højt tempo og mange bestillinger

• 
Kan bevare overblikket, når der er travlt

• 
Er kvalitetsbevidst og går op i detaljerne

• 
Er en naturlig leder, som kan skabe respekt og god energi omkring dig

• 
Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og fleksibel

• 
Har lyst til at være en del af en virksomhed i vækst

• 
Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø

Det vigtigste er dog ikke, at du kan det hele fra dag ét. Vi leder efter den rigtige person med den rigtige indstilling, som har lyst til at tage ansvar og udvikle sig sammen med restauranten.

Vi tilbyder

• 
En spændende stilling i en burgerrestaurant i vækst

• 
En central rolle i den daglige drift

• 
Mulighed for at udvikle dine ledelses- og køkkenfaglige kompetencer

• 
Et ungt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø

• 
Gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone

• 
Mulighed for at få indflydelse på restaurantens videre udvikling

• 
Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer

Lyder det som dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send din ansøgning og CV til info@smash-burger.dk og kontakt os på 28691238

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

 Bliv en del af vores team – og vær med til at bygge noget stort op sammen med os!

ENGLISH:

Sous Chef Wanted for a Growing Burger Restaurant

Are you passionate about food, quality, and great teamwork – and would you like to play an important role in a rapidly growing burger restaurant? Smash Burger Roskilde welcomes you...

We are looking for a skilled and dedicated Sous Chef to help us maintain high quality, an efficient kitchen operation, and a strong team.

We are a rapidly growing burger restaurant in Roskilde, and we are therefore looking for someone who is ready to take responsibility for the daily operations while also being motivated to grow and develop together with us.

Your Responsibilities

As Sous Chef, you will play a central role in the daily kitchen operations. Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Ensuring high quality and consistency in all our food

• 
Leading and motivating the kitchen team on a daily basis

• 
Ensuring good structure and efficiency during busy service periods

• 
Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees

• 
Ensuring that hygiene, cleaning, and food safety procedures are maintained

• 
Assisting the Head Chef with daily planning and kitchen operations

• 
Taking responsibility for the kitchen when the Head Chef is not present

• 
Contributing ideas for menu development, workflows, and kitchen operations

We Expect You To

• 
Have experience working in a professional kitchen – preferably as a Sous Chef, Chef, or in a similar position

• 
Thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high volume of orders

• 
Be able to stay calm and maintain an overview during busy periods

• 
Be quality-conscious and pay attention to detail

• 
Be a natural leader who can create respect and positive energy within the team

• 
Be reliable, responsible, and flexible

• 
Be motivated to become part of a growing business

• 
Have a positive attitude and contribute to a great working environment

Most importantly, you don't need to know everything from day one. We are looking for the right person with the right attitude – someone who is ready to take responsibility and grow together with the restaurant.

We Offer

• 
An exciting position in a growing burger restaurant

• 
A key role in the daily kitchen operations

• 
Opportunities to develop your leadership and culinary skills

• 
A young and dynamic working environment

• 
Great colleagues and an informal workplace culture

• 
The opportunity to influence the continued development of the restaurant

• 
Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

Does This Sound Like You?

Then we would love to hear from you!

Send your application and CV to info@smash-burger.dk or contact us on +45 28 69 12 38.

We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't hesitate to send your application today.

 Join our team – and be part of building something great together with us!

jobs.occupation: Plumber / Plumbing Installer - Plumbing & Heating - Lolland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Bang's VVS is looking for one qualified and experienced plumber / plumbing installer to join our team on Lolland, Denmark.

You'll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit. Unfortunately, we're not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will carry out varied plumbing work for private customers, businesses, industry and construction projects on Lolland.

We are looking for someone who:

Is a qualified plumber with relevant vocational training
Has practical experience as a plumber
Can work independently and deliver high-quality work
Is service-minded and comfortable working with customers
Can communicate in English
Has a category B driving licence
Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

What we offer

Gross hourly wage: DKK 180-220, depending on qualifications and experience
Candidates with several years of relevant experience can expect a salary at the higher end of the range
Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Pension scheme
5 weeks of vacation
Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension
Company vehicle
Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bang's VVS

Bang's VVS is an authorised Danish plumbing and sheet metal company established in 2016.

The company works with private customers, businesses, industry, agriculture and construction projects and handles both small and large projects. Bang's VVS places strong emphasis on quality workmanship, good customer service and energy-efficient solutions.

You will join an informal workplace with good colleagues, a high degree of independence and a strong focus on quality workmanship.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application to:

rekruttering@lolland.dk

Please write "Bang's VVS" in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe's largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit https://newcomers.lolland.dk/

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

Want to gain hands-on experience within cyber security and compliance, in critical IT infrastructure?

Join our Infrastructure & Security team and get hands-on experience with vulnerability management, audits, access governance, security reporting, and compliance activities. You'll work alongside experienced specialists and help protect business-critical systems while building valuable real-world skills.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

The Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnet, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centers, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

You can read more about Nordic RCC and the services we deliver on our website https://nordic-rcc.net/

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in ’Oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications’
jobs.description:
The Mads Clausen Institute, Center for Advanced Photovoltaics and Thin-Film Energy Devices (SDU CAPE) invites applications for a tenured Associate Professor position in ‘Oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications’. The starting date is Nov. 1st, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

What we offer
The Associate Professor position is a part of the SDU CAPE research center, which aims to develop new sustainable photovoltaics and energy technologies using scalable and green processing techniques. This includes activities bridging from synthesis of oxide semiconductors and thin films to their integrate in complete photovoltaic devices, to push the limits of new flexible thin film photovoltaics for the green energy transition. We offer an Associate Professor position within a dynamic research environment that includes students, researchers and research engineers. The position includes both research and teaching responsibilities.

What we expect

Candidates who have a previous PhD degree in a field relevant to the mentioned area may seek the position (physics, chemistry, material science, electrical engineering and similar). You must have a proven strong track record of publications within the areas of e.g. synthesis of oxide semiconductors and thin films, structure-property relationships, PVD processes for oxide thin film fabrication and scale-up, oxide thin films for photovoltaics applications e.g. as transparent conductive oxides, transport layers, active layers, light management layers or barrier layers. The candidate must have documented teaching experience (Assistant Prof. level). The ideal candidate has also documented supervision experience and demonstrated the ability to attract external research funding. Due to the interdisciplinary nature of the work, the candidates are expected to have excellent collaboration skills. A very good capability of communicating scientific results in English, both orally and in writing is required.

The Associate Professor is thus expected to: 

• 
Collaborate with other team members at SDU CAPE and supervise younger researchers

• 
Take responsibility for and lead new research directions within the overall area of oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications

• 
Contribute to establishing new innovation based activities within oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications

• 
Be responsible for teaching courses at SDU and supervise BSc, MSc and PhD students

• 
Contribute to obtaining funding for research and innovation projects

• 
Contribute to establishing and maintaining international collaborations

Workplace description / Research environment
We are an international research center working in the field of green energy technologies (CAPE), and we are looking for a highly motivated Associate Professor to join our CAPE research center at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), campus Sønderborg. We offer a modern, inclusive, international and interdisciplinary working environment with state-of-the-art facilities as well as a strong tradition of international collaboration. Our ambition is, to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both academic excellence and departmental development.

Having a focus on thin film technologies for energy conversion and storage, the center has full access to a surface science laboratory facility for the fabrication and characterization of thin films and photovoltaic devices, as well as a fully equipped Roll-to-Roll (R2R) facility for upscaling flexible devices. Our research center CAPE is a partner in various national and international research projects and networks that include collaboration partners from both academia and industry. SDU CAPE is also leading the new SDU Climate Cluster (SCC) Elite Center SOLEN, which span across four faculties at SDU to foster, in a cross-disciplinary manner, new thin film solar energy conversion and storage technologies based on green and sustainable solutions.

Read more and apply on: http://www.sdu.dk/en/stillinger
